name: Inkscape

1.how: inkscape --export-type=png|pdf|svg --export-filename=<out> <in>; --export-id=<id> --export-id-only; --actions='select-all;object-to-path;export-do' (inkscape --action-list shows every action); --shell for a REPL
1.notes: Nearly every menu command is an action callable from the CLI.

3.how: GTK4 tree for dialogs and toolbars; canvas is a drawing area.

quirks: SVG is text: for structural edits, editing the file directly is often simplest.
